title: "3. Functions"
description: "Learn to use built-in R functions and write your own, with live, editable R code."

R comes with hundreds of built-in functions (`sum()`, `sd()`, `sort()`...), and you can write your own with `function(...)`. The last evaluated expression inside a function is what it returns.

```{webr-r}
celsius_to_fahrenheit <- function(c) {
  f <- c * 9 / 5 + 32
  return(f)
}

celsius_to_fahrenheit(0)
celsius_to_fahrenheit(37)

sapply(c(0, 20, 37, 100), celsius_to_fahrenheit)
```
